scope: Selected organizations relevant to Colombia's sustainable-finance ecosystem. This is an analytical directory, not an exhaustive membership list or endorsement.

actors.name: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia
actors.description: Financial supervisor with a strategic agenda covering green finance and environmental and climate-risk management.

actors.name: Mesa de Finanzas Sostenibles de Colombia
actors.description: Collaboration platform connecting financial-system actors, national authorities and international partners to strengthen sustainable-finance practices.

actors.name: Centro Regional de Finanzas Sostenibles — Universidad de los Andes
actors.description: Academic center connecting research, public and private actors to scale sustainable-finance practice in Latin America.

actors.name: Bancóldex
actors.description: Development-finance institution providing business credit lines and programs through direct and intermediated channels.

actors.name: Findeter
actors.description: Development bank supporting territorial planning, structuring, financing and execution of sustainable projects.

actors.name: CAF — Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean
actors.description: Regional development bank financing public and private-sector projects and programs across Latin America and the Caribbean.

actors.name: BID Invest
actors.description: Private-sector arm of the IDB Group financing companies, financial institutions and infrastructure projects.

actors.name: International Finance Corporation (IFC)
actors.description: World Bank Group institution focused on private-sector investment and advisory in emerging markets.

actors.name: Asobancaria
actors.description: Banking-sector association active in sustainable-finance dialogue, capacity building and industry initiatives.
actors.source: Public industry role and sustainable-finance initiatives

actors.name: Bolsa de Valores de Colombia
actors.description: Capital-market infrastructure relevant to issuance, secondary markets and thematic financing instruments.

actors.name: Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) — Colombia
actors.description: International organization supporting green-growth and sustainable-finance capacity initiatives in Colombia.
actors.source: Public sustainable-finance capacity initiatives with Colombian authorities
